description: Malmaison — Colore: Grey, pink & gold stripes Codice: 5223 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Stripe Scala: Extra Small Altezza: 134 cm Rapporto: 26 cm × 0 cm Toni: Light grey, Pink The Chateau MALMAISON, a once derelict estate on Paris’s outskirts, was Josephine Bonaparte’s greatest project. As her husband’s mind was never far from the battlefield, the architects modeled the new entry after his striped military tent-- his home away from home. Inside MALMAISON, the theme continued in the Consul’s Chamber, where the same striped military fabrics covered the walls and ceiling. Heroic and stately, our striped MALMAISON brings history to the contemporary with sophisticated grandeur.
